Two equal payments spread cash receipt, lowering the largest payment to ₹23,010 and resulting in a modest peak unpaid value (₹9,500).
Four quarterly payments spread cash over a year, with a moderate largest payment of ₹35,400 and a moderate peak unpaid value (₹18,000).
Twelve monthly payments start later, each at ₹11,800, extending cash collection and yielding a higher peak unpaid value (₹22,000).
